# Vendored xterm.js assets

These browser assets are pinned and served locally so the authenticated Herdr
console doesn't depend on a CDN or require a broader Content Security Policy.

- `xterm.js` and `xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0
- `addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0
- Upstream: <https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js>
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
